title: Insane Grain

card.teaser: A health snack that refuses to look polite: a halftone mouth, real chilies and tall condensed type.

summary: A bold visual identity and snack packaging concept for Insane Grain, combining expressive typography, distressed graphics, and high-contrast colors to give the brand a rebellious personality.
meta: Pouch, Strikin' Hot flavor, graphic system, mockups

hero.alt: Insane Grain pouch: a halftone mouth, red chili and flame linework in red, black and white, with tall condensed type.

text: Insane Grain is a health snack brand aimed at a younger audience. The identity takes a more unconventional approach to health-food branding, using the energy of punk graphics and street culture to communicate the brand's character. The challenge was to make the packaging visually loud without sacrificing the clarity of the product name, flavor, and nutritional information.

finalDesign: The identity is built around a bold, high-impact visual language. Tall condensed lettering gives the brand name a strong presence, while distressed textures, halftone imagery, and sharp contrasts bring a raw, almost poster-like quality to the packaging.

The front of the pouch uses a halftone screaming mouth and a photographic chili pepper to communicate intensity and flavor. Wavy black-and-white stripes interrupt the composition, while red panels and splatter graphics create movement across the surface. The wordmark remains prominent against this busy background, with the flavor name and nutritional claims organized into a separate band at the bottom.

The contrast between the expressive graphics and the more structured information is intentional. The identity feels energetic and unconventional, but the hierarchy still gives the product a clear name, flavor, and set of nutritional details.
